basics.name: Eduardo López
basics.label: Founder and full stack AI engineer
basics.summary: Building startup products since 2015. Cofounded amiloz (over USD 3.5 million raised), a Y Combinator W22 company. As CTO, I built the first version of every product, then hired a team to continue the work. Now building Supervisor and Constructor, software to help SMBs run better using AI.

work.name: Supervisor
work.summary: Building software that lets teams run business operations through conversation.
highlights: Work spans product design, web and mobile interfaces, integrations, and agent workflows for questions, monitoring, and scheduled actions.
Building Constructor, a companion product for creating applications from a description.

work.name: amiloz
work.summary: Built the first products for a company supplying corner stores in Mexico. Y Combinator W22.
highlights: Built the first API, website, and iOS, Android, and web apps for customers, warehouses, and deliveries before fundraising.
We raised more than USD 3.5 million. I hired and led a technology team of seven in a company of 80 people.

details.title: From the first apps to the engineering team
paragraphs: Before we raised funding, I built the software myself: the API, website, and iOS, Android, and web applications for customers, warehouse teams, and delivery drivers. My remit also covered internal tools and analytics.

We went through Y Combinator W22, raised a little over USD 3.5 million during my time there, and served hundreds of business customers. The company reached 80 employees, including the technology team of seven that I hired and led.

details.title: The next direction
paragraphs: I wanted to focus fully on AI, while my cofounders wanted to pivot toward lending. We agreed on a founder separation that included a small personal exit. The company now operates as BelozFi.

work.name: Nixtla
work.summary: First and, for most of my time there, sole web engineer for a time series AI company.
highlights: Created the first API serving TimeGPT, the developer dashboard, and the website.
Own monitoring tools, analytics, HubSpot integrations, and internal AI products.

details.title: The first web engineer
paragraphs: As of October 2026, I had worked at Nixtla for a little over three years. I was the first web engineer and, for most of that time, the only person in that role. I continue as Head of Web.

details.title: TimeGPT and the developer experience
paragraphs: I created the first API serving the initial TimeGPT model, along with the developer dashboard and website. This covered the web products and interfaces through which developers accessed the forecasting service.

details.title: Monitoring, analytics, and internal products
paragraphs: I built monitoring tools and took responsibility for analytics and HubSpot integrations. My remit also includes several internal AI products that have not been publicly released.

work.name: freelance
work.summary: Web and mobile products for founders and growing teams.
highlights: Built Selia's first iOS, Android, and web apps, including booking, payments, and video consultations.
Built MarketPryce's iOS app, designed Ciro in Figma, and led CervezaSiempre for AB InBev.

details.title: Selia
paragraphs: Built the complete first version for therapists and patients across iOS, Android, and web. It included therapist discovery, connecting patients with therapists, booking, payments, and video sessions inside the app.

details.title: MarketPryce
paragraphs: Built the iOS app for discovering and connecting with sports influencers, including matching. That app is no longer in use.

details.title: Ciro
paragraphs: Redesigned the whole product in Figma. This engagement was entirely product design and did not include writing code.

details.title: CervezaSiempre for AB InBev
paragraphs: Led development of a beer subscription service for AB InBev. We launched in about a month and a half and reached thousands of customers over the following month and a half.
It was planned as a short engagement. After completing it, I moved to the role at Betterfin that I had already arranged.

work.name: Betterfin
work.summary: Built the frontend for a business financial insights and lending platform.

work.name: Zeel

details.title: Delivery products and team
paragraphs: My work covered the delivery apps, fleet tools, customer dashboards, and internal operations across iOS, Android, and web. I also managed a small engineering and design team.

work.name: Rappi
